delete.title: Delete Patient
delete.message: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}?

errors.non_anonymous_requires_name: A non-anonymous patient must have a name

manager.title: Duplicate patients
manager.panel_description: Records that carry the same name
manager.panel_body: Two records are proposed when they carry the same name, ignoring case and accents.
manager.panel_actions: “Merge” moves the procedures to the record you keep and deletes the other. “Not a duplicate” removes the pair from this list.

duplicates.load_error: The duplicates could not be loaded.
duplicates.merged: The two records have been merged.

merge_dialog.title: Merge “{{name}}”
merge_dialog.question: Which record do you want to keep?
merge_dialog.consequence_second_zero: Record 2 has no procedure: it will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
merge_dialog.consequence_second_one: The procedure of record 2 will move to record 1, then record 2 will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
merge_dialog.consequence_second_other: The {{count}} procedures of record 2 will move to record 1, then record 2 will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
merge_dialog.consequence_first_zero: Record 1 has no procedure: it will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
merge_dialog.consequence_first_one: The procedure of record 1 will move to record 2, then record 1 will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
merge_dialog.consequence_first_other: The {{count}} procedures of record 1 will move to record 2, then record 1 will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
merge_dialog.different_ssn: These two records have a different SSN: they may be two different people. The SSN of record {{record}} will not be kept.

error.gone: One of the two records no longer exists. The list has been updated.
error.not_a_pair: These two records no longer carry the same name. The list has been updated.
error.same_patient: The two records are the same one.
error.merge_failed: The merge failed. Nothing was changed.
